Render the field to a raster view

Source: R/fn_survey.R
survey_raster.Rd

Evaluates \(S(x)\) at the cell centres of a template, tile by tile. This is a view of the continuous model at a chosen resolution, not the model itself — call it again at a different resolution for a different view.

Usage

survey_raster(
  field,
  template = NULL,
  res = NULL,
  rescale = c("quantile", "max", "none"),
  q = 0.95,
  invert = FALSE,
  filename = "",
  ...
)

Arguments

field

a survey_field.

template

a terra SpatRaster whose geometry/CRS to match, or an SpatExtent; required alongside res when no template raster is given.

res

cell size in map units when building from an extent (ignored if template is a SpatRaster).

rescale

one of "quantile" (divide by the q quantile, clamped to 1; the default — "max" is hostage to a single survey hotspot, which flattens all other structure), "max" (divide by the max) or "none", to bring the view onto \([0, 1]\).

q

upper quantile for rescale = "quantile" (default 0.95: about the top 5 percent of the surface saturates to 1, giving the sparsity surface its fullest dynamic range without one hotspot owning the scale).

invert

if TRUE, return survey sparsity \(1 - \tilde S\) (requires a rescale other than "none"); this is the form the RankIndex consumes.

filename

optional output path (written via terra::writeRaster).

...

passed to terra::writeRaster.

Value

a single-layer SpatRaster.
